digest.component_or_area: git call site timeout bounding across gerrit_client and workspace modules
propositions: Network-capable git call sites in gerrit_client.py and workspace.py lack explicit timeout parameters, allowing indefinite blocking on stuck remotes or hung credential helpers

A timeout exception in gerrit_client.clone_change_ref propagates as raw subprocess.TimeoutExpired outside the token-redaction handler, creating a credential-disclosure vulnerability via TimeoutExpired.cmd
ref_lock.py git call sites are already bounded with required keyword-only timeout parameters; no edit needed

gerrit_client.py and workspace.py must each define _GIT_TIMEOUT = 300 and route subprocess.TimeoutExpired through their respective error handlers (GerritError and WorkspaceError) naming the operation and bound
Two deferred call sites in _commands/init.py and _commands/fsck_repair.py are blocked by in-progress bug 01e8 and split to task 983f-ee85-1e06-428e
git archive does not exhibit sequential promisor fetches and does not require timeout bounding in this scope
